name: Bianca Umali
bio: Bianca Umali, born Maria Isadora Bianca Soler Umali, is a Filipino actress known for roles in the fantasy series Mulawin vs. Ravena and Encantadia Chronicles: Sang’gre.

credits.title: Ella Arcangel: Ballad of Tooth and Claw
credits.overview: A young witch named Ella fights both humans and mythical monsters in the city to protect her community.

credits.title: Always Yours, Never Mine
credits.overview: Across thirty years, several almosts, and timing that is never quite right, two people keep crossing paths – always on the verge of being together, but never quite making it.

credits.title: Mananambal
credits.overview: A horror film starring Nora Aunor and Bianca Umali. Set in Siquijor, a Mananambal is a Filipino practitioner of traditional medicine, who is also capable of performing sorcery.

credits.title: Family History
credits.overview: A heartwarming story that seeks to teach family values, life, and marriage.

credits.title: Banal
credits.overview: It is a story of friends that were trapped while hiking in a haunted forest.

credits.title: Barbi D’ Wonder Beki
credits.overview: A coming-of-age film that tells the story of Billy Bayagan, a closeted gay in a family of strict and conservative policemen. The film follows his journey of acceptance and love for his true self.

credits.title: Alaala: A Martial Law Special
credits.overview: To commemorate the 45th anniversary of the declaration of Martial Law by former President Ferdinand Marcos, GMA Public Affairs presented “Alaala” with a special performance in which Alden Richards brought to life the experiences of Boni Ilagan, one of the victim of military brutality during the dictatorship.
